scope.purpose: Preserve semantically important state transitions with exact Git evidence so later reasoning does not reconstruct history from narrative memory.

record_when_any: A hard launch gate changes state.
A current-main compatibility witness is merged or superseded.
A launch-blocking issue is administratively closed/reopened in a way that could be confused with semantic PASS.
A canonical runtime/evidence tool is introduced, replaced, or materially hardened.
A falsification or first-break changes the next admissible gate.
A privacy, authority, or claim ceiling changes materially.
do_not_record_as_special_by_default: Routine CI queue movement with no semantic outcome.
Bot/site refresh commits with no project-state meaning.
Narrative claims not bound to an exact repository/PR/issue state.
recording_policy.future_append_rule: Create a new versioned ledger/addendum or append on a dedicated branch from exact current registry main; preserve old event IDs and never silently rewrite prior event meaning.

events.subject: Special-event persistence becomes an explicit meta-registry practice
events.state_before: Important transitions were mainly recoverable from PR/issue history and conversation summaries

events.meaning: Future JANUS work can distinguish event history from present-state snapshots and avoid losing why a gate changed.
